name: Interpolated Directional DWT
definition: A directional DWT variant allowing direction vectors with fractional coordinates ($d \in \mathbb{R}^3$), requiring sub-sampling and interpolation of prediction/update values.
summary: Interpolated Directional DWT uses fractional direction vectors and Lanczos interpolation to align with smooth volumetric features, differing from integer-based variants by enabling arbitrary directionality at the cost of higher complexity and negligible compression gains.
